inputs.text: Health workers took to the streets at Unity Fountain in Maitama on Thursday because the reform bills before the National Assembly are not just routine changes. The people pushing them seem to be using “reform” as cover to reshape the health sector from the top down, while those who know how the system works are left to bear the consequences. When workers from the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations are both protesting, that’s a warning sign—not something to brush off as noise.
